reviews.review: Had a great time playing this with friends. Cool concept and overall design that lead to a really fun experience.

I really don't understand how this game can be mostly positive. In VR and just in General this game makes OG DayZ look like a polished diamond. I have tried several playthroughs to like the game and give it a chance but it is just down right terrible. It is just an incredibly jumbled nightmare. Very terrible graphics. Terrible loot tables of random garbled mess. The giant alien ship that constantly just catches you while out in the open is just incredibly annoying. The controls are unplayable. You can't interact with your vest to save your life. However the AI is just as bad so you have plenty of opportunity to stare at them as you fiddle with your gear. I hate to ♥♥♥♥ on this game so hard but I can't find a single good thing about it I like. I would highly recommend on finding a better game until they can sort out this dumpster. Wasted my money for sure.

Ive played since launch and Im impressed with the progress. Still a bit rough around the edges but an awesome concept. Devs are NOT abandoning this game. Worth the buy. Still needs a community to fully enjoy but this game has the makings of a worthy VR title!
